title: A Counterexample to Kaplansky's Direct-Finiteness Conjecture in Characteristic Two
summary: We disprove Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture by constructing a finite field K of characteristic two, a finitely presented group G , and finite sums $`a,b\in K[G]`$ with $`ab=1`$ but $`ba\ne1`$. The group G is nonsofic. The same elements define a cellular automaton on K G that is injective but not surjective, disproving Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture.
family_title: A torsion-free group algebra that is not directly finite

review.reason: Disproves Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture in characteristic two via a finitely presented group.
